column4: the chain advanced unattended, height 2 -> 18: block arrival is itself the proposal trigger

nothing contains a compromise inside the node: CapDrop=null ReadonlyRootfs=false SecurityOpt=null (docker_opts passes no --cap-drop, --read-only or --security-opt, so the container keeps every default capability and a writable root)

the node's argv names a **key file** and that file is mode 600 inside the container: the file-protected form is what this net exercises, so the row's premise (no such flag anywhere under tools/) has moved

**the password is in the node's own environment, verbatim** (W-N6-04): `RNODE_VALIDATOR_PASSWORD` is set on PID 1 and nothing in the node clears or redacts it, so a same-host reader of /proc/1/environ has it in the clear
the public status carries the public key set only (HTTP 200)
the public API is plaintext: http returns 200 and https returns 000
the delegator read is not on the public port (404); the admin port answers it (200)
